_readme: The exact models/env shape a real onboarding converged to (2026-10-23, after six rejected attempts). Fill provider/model and env.mode. Rules: models entries are OBJECTS — provider + bare model + thinking as its OWN field; never a dotted string, never a ':thinking' suffix inside model (silently stored broken / invalid model id at the provider). The provider/model:thinking string form is valid ONLY in fallback arrays. Re-read the POST echo after every push and verify every models.* shows an object with a provider. A {} patch silently writes defaults — don't probe with it.
